notes.title: Patch 1.0.4a
notes.content:
Some bugs have been fixed and an improvement has been added.

[list]
[*] Zafir's Healing touch skill have been fixed. Now, you can use it in battle or anywhere else;
[*] Now, if you have 4 party members on the Dark Grotto maps, you'll be able to return to the castle via teleport. It is located at Dark Grotto I -  the first map you enter, close to the entrance.
[/list]
Male Doll Team
